headline: Congress extended a federal program that funds breast health education, research, and support for young women through fiscal year 2019.
what_it_does: The law renews the EARLY Act of 2009 through fiscal year 2019. That program supports public and health care professional education about breast health in young women, research on preventing breast cancer in young women, and support for young women who have breast cancer. The law also directs the Government Accountability Office to report on what the Department of Health and Human Services has done under the program and whether any of its work overlaps with other efforts.

who_it_affects.how: The renewed program can fund education, prevention research, and support services aimed at breast health and breast cancer in younger women.
The program may provide education materials and campaigns about breast health in young women.
Federal funding for prevention research in young women continues through fiscal year 2019.

who_it_affects.group: Department of Health and Human Services
who_it_affects.how: The department must keep running EARLY Act activities and must cooperate with a GAO review of their scope and any overlap with other efforts.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 18, 2014, and the reauthorization runs through fiscal year 2019.
